value.title: Share your rides in Pamplona
value.body: Ride with students, faculty and staff of the Universidad de Pamplona. Get to class together and spend less.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Drivers publish their trips and passengers request a seat. The driver approves, and the cost contribution is paid outside the app.

safety.title: Your safety first
safety.body: Only the university community with a verified ID can join. You can share your trip live and there is an emergency button.

fields.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Use a phrase you remember.
fields.fullNameHint: As it appears on your ID or certificate.
fields.sexHint: It must match your document. It enables women-only trips.

form.minLength: It must have at least {{min}} characters.
form.maxLength: It must have at most {{max}} characters.

email_verification.title: Verify your email
email_verification.why: This confirms the university email is yours.

two_factor.title: Confirm it is you
two_factor.why: We ask for it on your first sign-in and after a password change.

password_reset.title: Reset your password
password_reset.why: Enter it together with your new password.

verify.codeHint: It expires in {{minutes}} minutes. Check your spam folder too.
verify.resendIn: You can request another code in {{seconds}} s
verify.resent: We sent you a new code.

expired.title: Your verification expired
expired.body: For security the process lasts a few minutes. Sign in again and we will send you another code.

help.data: Use your real name and your university email.

help.terms: Review your details and accept the terms to finish.

passenger.body: I look for trips and request seats from drivers.

driver.title: Driver
driver.body: I offer seats in my car or motorcycle.
